prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a 9:16 hyper-realistic direct-flash portrait of a generic adult woman with long voluminous hair and face-framing strands, a gentle smile and direct eye contact. She wears a crisp white puff-sleeve top with a flattering sweetheart neckline, small silver hoops, a delicate silver necklace and a thin ring. Her hands form a heart gesture near the chest. Set her at a dark upscale restaurant table with partial wine glasses, wood surfaces and warm blurred bokeh lights. Use harsh high-contrast flash, realistic natural skin texture, deep shadows, glossy but restrained highlights and a premium candid portrait aesthetic. Do not reproduce the named celebrity likeness or add body emphasis beyond the reference fashion framing.
